name: vllm-cuda-spark
description: vLLM v0.22.0 for NVIDIA DGX Spark (sm_121), assembled from a prebuilt wheel. Thin assembler: installs the vllm-cuda-spark-wheel pkg (vllm-*.whl built with the CUDA-13.0 toolkit -> PTX 9.0, native sm_121 SASS, which fixes cudaErrorUnsupportedPtxVersion on Marlin/AWQ) into the vllm-openai aarch64 base with --no-deps, ~2-5 min, no compiler. flash-attn stays as the base ships it (production path uses TRITON_ATTN + TORCH_SDPA). To bump vLLM, rebuild vllm-cuda-spark-wheel first. Legacy compile-in-place Dockerfile kept at Dockerfile.legacy. build_host spark1 (spark2 intermittent 2026-06).
